```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# 1. Buka data airquality
data(airquality)
str(airquality)

# 2. Buat histogram untuk variabel Wind, sertakan pula density nya
# Histogram dengan breaks mulai dari 0
hist(airquality$Wind,
     breaks = 0 + (0:11) * 2,
     xlab = "Wind speed (mph)",
     main = "Histogram A: Breaks di 0, 2, 4, ...")

# Histogram dengan breaks mulai dari 1
hist(airquality$Wind,
     breaks = 1 + (0:11) * 2,
     xlab = "Wind speed (mph)",
     main = "Histogram B: Breaks di 1, 3, 5, ...")

# Density
dens_wind <- density(airquality$Wind)
hist(airquality$Wind,
     breaks = 0 + (0:11) * 2,
     probability = TRUE,
     xlab = "Wind speed (mph)",
     main = "Histogram + Density Curve: Wind")
lines(dens_wind, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# 3. Buat boxplot dan steam and leaf
# Boxplot
boxplot(airquality$Wind, horiz = TRUE,
        main = "Boxplot Wind Speed",
        xlab = "Wind speed (mph)")

# Stem and leaf
stem(airquality$Wind)

# 4. Buat scatter plot
# Scatterplot Ozone vs Wind
plot(Ozone ~ Wind, data = airquality,
     pch = 16,
     main = "Scatterplot: Ozone vs Wind Speed",
     xlab = "Wind speed (mph)",
     ylab = "Ozone (ppb)")

# Tambahkan rug plot pada sumbu x dan y
rug(airquality$Wind)
rug(airquality$Ozone[!is.na(airquality$Ozone)], side = 2)

# Panel A: skala linear
plot(Ozone ~ Wind, data = airquality,
     xlab = "Wind speed (mph)", ylab = "Ozone (ppb)",
     main = "Panel A: Skala Linear")

# Panel B: skala logaritmik pada Ozone
plot(log(Ozone) ~ Wind, data = airquality,
     xlab = "Wind speed (mph)", ylab = "log(Ozone)",
     main = "Panel B: Skala Logaritmik")
```
